oembed.title: Git Setup from Scratch | Git Tutorial | Git Series #20

segs.utf8: To set up Git from scratch on a new machine, first install the git cli package.
Next, configure your global username with git config --global user.name.
Then set your global email address using git config --global user.email.
Finally, run git init inside your project folder and verify with git status.

ground_truth_steps: Install the Git CLI package on the machine
Configure global username with git config --global user.name
Configure global email with git config --global user.email
Initialize repository with git init and verify with git status

segs.utf8: Using the difflib module in Python standard library we can generate Git-style unified diffs.
Import unified_diff from difflib and pass two lists of lines with fromfile and tofile labels.
Iterate over the returned generator and print each diff line to inspect additions and removals.

ground_truth_steps: Import unified_diff from Python's built-in difflib module
Pass original and modified line sequences with fromfile and tofile names
Render the unified diff generator output to inspect line changes
